title: Known Limitation: channel_id
description: Synthetic demo; paid_at in Asia/Shanghai, [2026-08-01, 2026-09-01). Actual outcome is determined by runtime validation.
question: Known Limitation: channel_id

runtime_request.candidate_sql: SELECT o.channel_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price - i.discount_amount) AS gross_gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND o.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' GROUP BY o.channel_id
